name: mapping_holdout_v1
provenance: Blind held-out mapping benchmark. Written before reading the mapper's ABBREVIATIONS, synonym or schematic dictionaries and never tuned against. One author; public-schema tables (Synthea, OMOP person, Salesforce Contact, HubSpot contact, Stripe Charge) recalled from public documentation.
split_method: Table-level split, stratified by bucket (the single-table 'negatives' bucket is pooled with 'real_world_standard', which holds the other negatives). Inside each stratum tables are ordered by sha256('datawrap-holdout-v1:' + id); the first ceil(n/2) are 'test', the rest 'dev'. Tune only on dev. The test split's answers must never appear in dictionaries, synonym lists or other fixtures (tests/test_mapping_holdout_leak.py).

known_overlap_at_freeze.recorded_at: 2026-11-21, origin/feature/Cleanup 32bdc4ba6, before any tuning on this set
known_overlap_at_freeze.note: Test-split answers that the mapper's dictionaries, synonym lists, training data or mapping fixtures already contained when the set was frozen. They are real contamination and part of why some test columns map. tests/test_mapping_holdout_leak.py fails on any overlap not listed here.
